commit.message:
feat(reports): split child safety into three distinct report categories (#364)

* feat(reports): split child safety into three distinct report categories

Splits the single "Child safety concern" report reason into:
- Child Safety Violation (general catch-all)
- Child Sexual Abuse (actual CSAM)
- User Appears Under 16 (age concern)

Refs: divinevideo/divine-mobile#3489

* fix: add NIP-56/NIP-32 mapping helpers, normalize label casing

Address review feedback:
- Add toNip56ReportType and toNip32ReportLabel mapping helpers aligned
  with mobile's content_reporting_service.dart mappings.
- Use helpers in useReportContent instead of leaking raw enum values
  into protocol tags (fixes NS-sexual-content → NS-sexualContent, etc).
- Normalize new report labels to sentence case matching existing pattern.
- Add test coverage for every ContentFilterReason mapping.

* Pin Node 20 for Pages builds

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
fix(dm): surface bunker decrypt failures in moderator inbox (#312)

* fix(dm): surface bunker decrypt failures in moderator inbox

unwrapDmGiftWrap collapsed every failure path (signer/RPC error,
malformed seal, hash mismatch, recipient mismatch) into a null return;
fetchDmMessages dropped them without preserving any signal. A moderator
inbox where the bunker rejected nip44_decrypt rendered as "No other
messages yet" — identical to a genuinely empty inbox.

Replace null returns with a discriminated DmUnwrapResult, aggregate
outcomes in FetchDmMessagesResult, plumb through useDmMessages, and
expose useDmInboxStatus so MessagesPage can render an explicit
"inbox temporarily unavailable" state when every fetched wrap failed
to decrypt.

Closes #309

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(dm): apply PR review feedback

- useDirectMessages.ts: replace ?? cascade in setQueryData updater with
  explicit ternary. Same behavior, clearer intent.
- dm.test.ts: extract createDmTestWrap and createMockSigner helpers next
  to createTestSigner; refactor three failure-path tests.
- MessagesPage.test.tsx: import DmInboxStatus instead of redeclaring
  the inline union.
- dm.ts: add TODO(#321) above attestation/hash mismatch checks for the
  malformed sub-classification follow-up.
- useDirectMessages.test.ts: fix test seeds to use FetchDmMessagesResult
  shape; prior bare-array seeds were masked by the old defensive
  ?? cascade in updateDmMessageCaches.
- Add docs/brainstorm/ doc capturing review-response analysis and trace
  findings (referenced from #322).

Refs #312, #321, #322.

* chore(dm): drop brainstorm doc from PR

Per review feedback on #312: the design-rationale doc is a process
artifact, not a feature deliverable. AGENTS.md requires PRs to stay
tightly scoped.

Refs #312.

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
feat(og): /embed/:id + OG coverage for @username, hashtags, search, discovery, apex (#358)

* docs: spec for OG / Twitter Card link preview fixes

Documents the root cause of bare-link Slack unfurls (meta-refresh in
crawler HTML) and the planned two-PR rollout: urgent tag fix first,
then /embed/:id route and broader route coverage.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: implementation plan for OG/Twitter Card link previews

13 tasks across 2 PRs. PR 1 fixes the meta-refresh bug + adds player
tags (the urgent Slack fix). PR 2 lands /embed/:id, route coverage,
and prod validation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(compute-js): extract ogTags helpers into their own module

Pull buildCrawlerHtml, escapeHtml, cleanText, truncateText out of
index.js into compute-js/src/ogTags.js so they can be unit-tested
in jsdom without Fastly bindings.

Key behaviour changes vs. inline version:
- Remove <meta http-equiv="refresh"> (fixes Slack unfurl bail-out)
- Add og:image:width / og:image:height (default 1200×630, overridable)
- Add optional video block for og:video:* and twitter:player:*
- Replace "Redirecting to..." body with a plain link

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(compute-js): only emit og:image dims when both supplied; set defaults at call sites

Drop the hard-coded 1200×630 defaults from buildCrawlerHtml (now null/null)
and only emit og:image:width / og:image:height meta tags when both values are
truthy.  Pass explicit 1200×630 at the video (with videoMeta passthrough hook
for Task 3) and category call sites; leave handleProfileOgTags without dims so
avatars no longer claim to be 1200×630.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(compute-js): cover buildCrawlerHtml refresh removal + video block

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): wire og:video + twitter:player into video page OG tags

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): extract videoUrl + dimensions from imeta for og:video

Extract fetchVideoMetadata parsing into a pure videoMetadata.js module with
parseImetaTag and transformVideoApiResponse functions. Adds videoUrl, videoMime,
videoWidth, videoHeight, imageWidth, imageHeight to the returned metadata object,
enabling handleVideoOgTags to emit the og:video block and twitter:card=player
for video pages with playable URLs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): add /embed/:id route for twitter:player iframes

Adds renderEmbedPage() (pure, zero-dep) and wires /embed/:id in the
Fastly edge worker before crawler detection so all clients — humans,
crawlers, and iframe hosts — receive the minimal autoplaying loop page.
CSP frame-ancestors * allows embedding from any origin; no X-Frame-Options
header is set. Six unit tests cover video attrs, poster omission, XSS
escaping, null-video fallback, mime default, and title rendering.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): extract crawlerHandlers module + add /@username OG handler

Refactors bech32 helpers and all crawler-OG handlers out of the 700-line
index.js into focused modules (bech32.js, crawlerHandlers.js) and adds
handleAtUsernameOg so social-media crawlers hitting /@username get proper
Open Graph / Twitter Card HTML with profile data from Funnelcake.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): add /t/:tag hashtag OG handler

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): add /search OG handler

Add handleSearchOgTags for /search?q=... to crawlerHandlers.js. No
funnelcake call needed — query is echoed into title/description with
the default OG image. 6 new tests added; all 51 compute-js tests pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): add /discovery[/:type] OG handler

Add handleDiscoveryOgTags for /discovery and /discovery/:type routes,
fetching the top video thumbnail from Funnelcake for richer link previews.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(compute-js): add apex / OG handler with top trending thumbnail

Crawlers hitting divine.video/ now receive a full OG/Twitter Card page
with the current top trending thumbnail (falls back to /og.png 1200x630).
Human visitors continue to receive the SPA with injected feed data unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(compute-js): replace `as any` with `as unknown as string` in crawler tests

ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` was failing CI on the two
intentional null-input cases that exercise graceful handling. `unknown` keeps
the test's intent (force-cast a null past the typed signature) without
tripping the rule.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(compute-js): resolve duplicate imports + restore consts after main merge

The "Update branch" merge of main (with PR1 squashed) into PR2's branch
left compute-js/src/index.js with two issues that broke CI:

1. Duplicate `escapeHtml` import — once on its own line, once inside the
   wider ogTags import added by main's PR1 squash. ESLint flagged this as
   a parsing error ("Identifier 'escapeHtml' has already been declared").
2. Duplicate `fetchVideoMetadata` and other handlers — both inline (kept
   from main, with staging-aware funnelcakeTarget) and imported from
   crawlerHandlers.js (added by PR2).
3. `DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE` and `DEFAULT_SITE_DESCRIPTION` const definitions
   referenced throughout the file but dropped by the merge.
4. `FUNNELCAKE_API_URL` const left over from PR2's pre-staging-routing
   branch, never referenced in this file (dead code).

Resolution:
- Consolidate imports: keep main's `funnelcakeOrigin`, `wellKnownPaths`,
  ogTags (full set), bech32, embedPage, plus PR2's *new* handlers from
  crawlerHandlers.js (handleAtUsernameOg, handleHashtagOgTags,
  handleSearchOgTags, handleDiscoveryOgTags, handleApexOgTags). Drop the
  4 imports that duplicated inline functions to preserve staging-routing
  via getFunnelcakeOriginForApiHost.
- Restore DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE and DEFAULT_SITE_DESCRIPTION.
- Remove the dead FUNNELCAKE_API_URL const.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
